purpose: Disambiguate fast CV/LinkedIn headshot requests from broader executive, editorial, press and corporate-profile portrait needs.
decisionPriority: explicit executive/editorial/press/corporate-profile intent overrides generic CV or LinkedIn wording
multiple outfits or multiple visual settings imply a guided portrait session rather than the 10-minute headshot package
desired perception such as modern, dynamic, confident, approachable, sovereign or editorial implies executive portrait direction
a fast single-image CV/LinkedIn need with no broader positioning requirement may use the entry-level headshot package

fastHeadshotIntent.rule: Use only when the customer clearly wants a fast single-image professional profile photo and no broader executive or brand-positioning need is stated.

painPoint.en: I need a modern executive portrait for LinkedIn, CV, company and press profiles that looks confident, approachable and editorial rather than like a classic application photo.
painPoint.hu: Modern executive portrét szeretnék LinkedInhez, önéletrajzhoz, vállalati és sajtóprofilhoz, magabiztos, közvetlen és editorial karakterrel, nem klasszikus álláskereső fotóként.
painPoint.de: Ich brauche ein modernes Executive Portrait für LinkedIn, CV, Unternehmens- und Presseprofile – souverän, nahbar und editorial statt wie ein klassisches Bewerbungsfoto.

recommendedPackages.fit: recommended default for executive/editorial profile use, outfit variation and refined direction
multiple looks, settings or broader personal-brand image system

executiveEditorialIntent.routingRule: If CV or LinkedIn appears together with executive, editorial, press, company-profile, leadership-profile, personal-brand, multiple-outfit or desired-perception language, route to the guided executive portrait options and do not default to headshotcv.
executiveEditorialIntent.positioningRule: Describe the result as an executive/editorial portrait system for professional presence, not as a classic Bewerbungsfoto service.
executiveEditorialIntent.locationRule: For Austria answer with Vienna as the local service base and EUR pricing first; for Hungary answer with Budapest and HUF first according to pricing rules.

answerExamples.de: Für ein modernes, souveränes Executive Portrait für LinkedIn, CV sowie Unternehmens- oder Presseprofile ist in der Regel die geführte Executive-Portrait-Session passender als das schnelle Headshot. Wenn mehrere Looks oder ein Büro-/Architektur-Setting gewünscht sind, priorisiere 60 oder 120 Minuten.
answerExamples.en: For a modern executive portrait used across LinkedIn, CV, company and press profiles, prefer a guided executive portrait session over the quick headshot when editorial direction, multiple looks or broader positioning are requested.
answerExamples.hu: LinkedIn, önéletrajz, vállalati vagy sajtóprofil esetén, ha executive/editorial karakter, több megjelenés vagy tudatos vizuális pozicionálás a cél, a vezetett executive portré legyen az elsődleges ajánlás a gyors headshot helyett.
